title: My Family's Work
text:
My mother is a doctor. She works at a big hospital in our city. Every day she helps sick people. She starts work at eight o'clock in the morning.

My father is a teacher. He works at a school near our house. He teaches math to children. He loves numbers, so he enjoys his job very much.

questions.text: What subject does the father teach?
What kind of person is the mother most likely to be?
Why is the father happy with his job?
options: He earns a lot of money
He works only one day a week

vocabulary.definition: a person who treats sick people
a place where sick people are cared for
a person who teaches students in a school
symbols used for counting and calculating

paragraph_translations: Моя мама — лікар. Вона працює у великій лікарні в нашому місті. Щодня вона допомагає хворим людям. Вона починає роботу о восьмій годині ранку.
Мій тато — вчитель. Він працює у школі біля нашого дому. Він викладає математику дітям. Він любить числа, тому йому дуже подобається його робота.
